# Prefix -> URI bindings the inventory in expressions.txt is compiled against, one
# "prefix<TAB>uri" pair per line. Read by gen/XPathOracle.java and by TestKnownAnswers.
#
# This is what DSS 6.5.RC1 hands to XPathUtils.registerNamespace, which is the only way a
# prefix enters the NamespaceContextMap the XPath engine resolves against. Every line names
# the call site it came from; nothing here is invented.
#
#   ds, xades111, xades122, xades132, xades141, xadesen, saml2
#       DSSXMLUtils.registerXAdESNamespaces(). Note the source comment "DO NOT register
#       'xades'": the unversioned prefix appears in javadoc only, never in a query string,
#       so it is absent here too.
#   tl  TLStructureVerifier, XAdESTrustedListUtils, AbstractTrustedListWithSha2Predicate
#   asic, manifest
#       ASiCWithXAdESService, ASiCEWithXAdESManifestParser, ASiCManifestParser
#   ers XMLEvidenceRecordAnalyzer
#   mra, ns5
#       AbstractMRALOTLTest. MRANamespace.NS is never registered by main code, so in a
#       main-only configuration "mra:" would resolve to the null namespace; the MRA test
#       harness is the configuration in which MRAPath's expressions select anything, and it
#       is the one pinned here.
#   h   XAdESLevelBEnvelopedWithXPathPlacementAfterTest / ...FirstChildTest / ...NoneTest
#   xsd XAdESEnumsTest, ASiCEnumsTest
#
# The rule for a prefix that is NOT in this file is pinned separately, in
# TestUnregisteredPrefixIsNullNamespace: NamespaceContextMap.getNamespaceURI returns
# XMLConstants.NULL_NS_URI, so an unknown prefix silently means "no namespace".
ds	http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#
xades111	http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.1.1#
xades122	http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.2.2#
xades132	http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.3.2#
xades141	http://uri.etsi.org/01903/v1.4.1#
xadesen	http://uri.etsi.org/19132/v1.1.1#
saml2	urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion
tl	http://uri.etsi.org/02231/v2#
asic	http://uri.etsi.org/02918/v1.2.1#
manifest	urn:oasis:names:tc:opendocument:xmlns:manifest:1.0
ers	urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:ers
mra	http://ec.europa.eu/tools/lotl/mra/schema/v2#
ns5	http://uri.etsi.org/TrstSvc/SvcInfoExt/eSigDir-1999-93-EC-TrustedList/#
h	http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/
xsd	http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema
